crypto_primitives: Argon2id, PBKDF2, HKDF, SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256, AES, ChaCha, BLAKE2b-512, BLAKE2s, Camellia, Twofish, Whirlpool
primary_platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS, BSD, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, ARM64
implementation_attack_surface: Heap buffer overflow, out-of-bounds reads, excessive memory allocations, cryptographic errors on big-endian processors, alignment crashes, and screen-capture exposure are discussed.
qrng_&_entropy_sources: Secure random-byte generation and system entropy gathering are mentioned.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: ARM64 platform support; smart card and security-token data handling are mentioned.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Bundled zlib, LZMA SDK, libzip, and FUSE library updates are mentioned.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Windows feature-update preparation, boot-loader certificate migration, Rescue Disk recreation, recovery backups, and downgrade backups are discussed.

evidence.Crypto Primitives: Add Argon2id as an alternative memory-hard KDF for non-system volumes.
